newsitem.title: USA: U.S. mortgage-backeds trim losses, finish flat.
newsitem.headline: U.S. mortgage-backeds trim losses, finish flat.

text.p: U.S.mortgage-backed securities trimmed earlier losses in step with Treasuries to end a quiet day virtually unchanged.

At noon, the Fed reported U.S. business activity as "generally good" and said it was "expanding moderately." The report spurred pass-through securities to pull back from their earlier losses, a trader said.

"I think some short-trades have been set up on a day trading basis in front of (the Beige Book report)," said a trader, adding that after the report was released current coupons "picked up a few ticks."
